technique_name: Design an algorithm to predict the stock market using the given conditions.
description: The algorithm can use a combination of supervised and unsupervised machine learning techniques to predict stock market trends. First, a supervised learning model such as a support vector machine can be trained on the dataset to generate a model that can be used to predict stock prices. Then, an unsupervised learning algorithm, such as a clustering technique, can be used to analyze the relationship between different economic indicators such as GDP and unemployment rate, and company-specific data
example:
A. The dataset includes information related to economic indicators, such as GDP and unemployment rates, as well as company-specific data such as earnings, market capitalization, and financial ratios.
B. The algorithm should be able to predict the market trend over a period of at least one month.
